name: Chromatic Metal
description: A metal alloy with an engineered nanostructured surface layer that produces angle-dependent color shifts, similar to a soap bubble or oil film but permanent and durable. The effect is structural rather than pigment-based, so it never fades. Used in luxury vehicle bodies, high-end architecture, and jewelry. Each batch can be tuned to a specific color palette.
